verdict.rationale: Teller publishes API reference pages for balances, transactions, identity, payments and webhooks, and it offers a simulated-data sandbox environment. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference with runnable or try-it examples. The sandbox is a separate test environment, not an in-docs runnable explorer, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no spec to drive an interactive console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
